researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory and GPX/API baseline. HÖ22 GPX has 1103 trackpoints, one segment, 24.151149 km, start 57.42843/14.06862, end 57.46530/13.89036, two gaps over 100 m, none over 150 m, no duplicate coordinate values, HÖ21-HÖ22 gap 6.053 m, HÖ22-HÖ23 gap 1.280 m and direct GPX available while .kml/.geojson/.json variants returned 404/406 HTML.

Required six-lane HÖ22 research completed. No second targeted batch was needed because remaining issues are normalization/currentness caveats: Grönelund versus Skillingaryd endpoint modeling, Åsafors pickup/dropoff/no-transit access, Kylås/Bissefäll/Hagstad facility classification, fire-status contradiction, post-Storm-Dave unknown clearance, no public potable water and OSM relation scope.
Main thread synthesized HÖ22 into this section JSON. The section is ready for normalization with caveats.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ22 has navigation-grade official GPX/API geometry, strong endpoint continuity with HÖ21 and HÖ23, clear shared endpoint coordinates at Grönelund and Åsafors, usable start access via Skillingaryd station, and sufficient six-lane coverage. Main caveats are Grönelund versus Skillingaryd endpoint modeling, Åsafors no-parking/no-close-transit access, Kylås and Bissefäll private/bookable facility classification, Hagstad pending verification, no public potable water, dynamic/conflicting fire status, post-Storm-Dave unknown clearance and OSM relation 15427025 spanning HÖ22+HÖ23 rather than exact HÖ22.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Grönelund west of Skillingaryd, HÖ22 follows the Höglandsleden west branch through a long forest-and-gravel-road stage toward Åsafors, passing the Bissefäll and Kylås/Kyllesjön corridor before reaching the shared HÖ22/HÖ23 endpoint. Skillingaryd station is useful public-transport access via the unmarked connector, while Åsafors is best treated as pickup/dropoff only. Use the official GPX as route geometry, keep bookable/private facilities distinct from public shelters, and verify fire status plus post-Storm-Dave trail clearance before publication.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ23 Åsafors-Kärringabacka. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
